verdict.rationale: Vanta's Trust Center is explicitly described as automating security reviews, and the broader platform documentation confirms continuous, automated evidence collection, control status monitoring, and integrations (e.g., docs-10, docs-19, docs-45) that would feed subprocessor/document/control data without manual updates. Third-party risk monitoring (docs-13/14) also supports automated vendor/subprocessor tracking. missing for 10: no explicit documentation tying Trust Center subprocessor list updates or document renewal automation specifically, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that Trust Center content refreshes automatically without manual publishing steps.
